reviews.text: They solved a problem that had gone undiagnosed for 2 years in 30 minutes.

I come from Torrejón de Ardoz and I don't mind because they are true professionals and it's clear they love animals. I just want to say thank you for dedicating yourselves wholeheartedly to them and for taking care of my old dog, Grandpa.
They are fantastic

A huge thank you to those two amazing professionals who helped us give our furry friend Naranjito a new lease on life.
You guys are fantastic!

And thanks to Chema and David who happened to be passing by; your work is pure love.

An unbeatable team, both with my pet Nala and with us. Highly qualified staff, starting with the kind and personal touch of Jose, Flor, and all the other colleagues. Thank you, Jose, for teaching us something new every time we visit. 100% recommended, not 200%.

I need to edit and change my review to complete the experience. Borja was very considerate of my dog; he did the checkups quickly and occasionally trimmed his dewclaw. I discovered the clinic because I heard about Pepe. "Pepe has a great eye," "Pepe can tell what's wrong with a dog just by looking at you." I went in with a rare case, though I knew it was unusual. We'd been going from vet to vet... and with everything we had written down in a folder, I kept them updated. I only saw Pepe three times when we crossed paths, and he didn't show any interest, even though they were completely baffled by the episodes of what seemed like cognitive decline, but turned out to be brain fog. They kept asking me, "What do you think it could be?" Let's just say that if he gets through it, I'll be there.

The clinic is almost an hour away from me; the surrounding area is a green or blue zone.

A palliative IV therapy system was devised to help my dog, but after a terrible appointment, I practically turned around at the door and had to go to another clinic. Then I discovered they were charging me double what I would pay anywhere else (even expensive hospitals) for several IV therapy sessions. They neglected to explain that it was equivalent to the subcutaneous IV fluids I was giving him at home. Under their supervision, a lump on his neck went from being the size of a chickpea to being the size of a walnut, and I was the one who noticed it. His eye looked strange; they told me to moisturize it, schedule a follow-up appointment, and when I saw him again... we were going over everything again from the beginning as if I had ZERO memory of the whole thing. By the way: don't prescribe eye cream when there are eye drops available. The cream is unusable. The red-haired assistant (sorry, I don't know your name) was the best.
They're all great and the service is very friendly.
One of the best vets around!!!! Thank you for treating my Neus so well!!!

Pepe is wonderful. The only downside is that he's always very busy, making it difficult to get a time that works best for me. Since he started treating Vega, I've been delighted. He's treating her illness with so much care, even though I live quite far away. I always manage to make time to go to this vet. The reception staff were very kind and attentive. Everything was spotless, and I'd give it a perfect 1000 if I could.
They are undoubtedly the best veterinarians
I'm so grateful to Pepe and Flor and their whole team for their expertise. They're helping my dogs so much. What a difference compared to other vets!

I would like to express my sincere gratitude for the excellent treatment and the warm, caring service we received at this veterinary clinic. I truly believe it is the best I have ever experienced.

From the moment we brought in our guinea pig, who was very ill, the entire team was incredibly dedicated and attentive. They not only provided exceptional help but also took the time to explain to my daughters how to care for our other pet, which I greatly appreciate.

I especially want to highlight their willingness to see us even when we called shortly before closing time with our guinea pig in critical condition. From the very first moment, everyone's treatment was exquisite.

Furthermore, they surprised us with lovely little gifts, which further demonstrates their commitment and genuine warmth.

I have nothing but wonderful things to say about my experience and I highly recommend them.
Great professionals, of which there are few left.

A veterinary clinic with extraordinary professionals who go the extra mile for pets, demonstrating a superior love for animals, using excellent techniques, achieving fast results, and showing tremendous enthusiasm for our furry friends to leave the clinic healthy and happy. Best of all, they offer natural treatments. Thank you for everything!
The best treatment and veterinarian in the world

This clinic has treated my dog ​​Mina wonderfully. Thanks to Borja for all the love he gave her these past 13 years. I used to live in the neighborhood, but then I moved, and I still kept coming to this clinic. Now Mina is watching us from heaven and she must be so happy because they always took care of her. Thank you, thank you, and thank you!

I am so grateful to Pepe and his entire team.
They saved my cat. Last year she had kidney problems, and I arrived with her practically dying in my arms. Before going there, I had been to other clinics that only wanted to take my money and treated me terribly. I will be forever grateful, and today she is here stronger than ever.

Pepe is the best veterinarian I've ever known, and I've been around all kinds of animals my whole life. I've been taking my dog ​​to him since I was in Ciempozuelos. He was paralyzed, and thanks to Pepe, he's doing great now.

The best in all of Madrid, without a doubt! You can really tell when someone loves their profession... I've known them for years, and they never disappoint. If they need to give you a little "scolding" for doing something wrong, like letting your dog get too fat, they'll tell you. They have a close relationship with the owners and are incredibly caring with their patients. They always treat them as if they were their own. In their treatments, they always prioritize the animal's well-being and minimize any potential side effects. Thanks to the whole amazing veterinary team!

Mr. Figueroa offers online consultations. Since I live far away and was desperate, I booked an appointment online. I explained my problem, sent him lab results, he prescribed treatment, and told me he would help and that I should contact him if anything came up. The consultation cost me €50. He was nice that day, but of course, when he got paid. After that, I contacted him twice more, and he left me hanging like a cigarette butt. He even had the nerve to tell me he couldn't know without seeing the cat. Well, don't offer online consultations. I trusted him, and it was a complete slap in the face.
I've been taking my little ones there for almost two years now, and I'm very grateful for how they treat us and the results in my dogs' health.

They are a wonderful team, excellent professionals and wonderful people. They cared for my dog ​​for many years until his passing at 15. Special thanks to Borja, our regular veterinarian, for his kindness and professionalism. I will always recommend them!
Great service, however sarurdays can be long wait due to emergency clients

Excellent staff, very friendly, they helped us with the travel paperwork for our two dogs, vaccinated one of them, and the prices are very good. But most importantly, the service is excellent; you can tell they enjoy what they do and love animals.

My lifelong clinic, great professionals especially Borja who is always attentive to everything and makes sure everything goes well, good care and dedication to ensure our pets are well, in my case a kitten.
Excellent treatment of both pets and their owners... friendly and practical. Good professionals.
Excellent professionals. Unfortunately, I've had to visit many different veterinary clinics, and they've become my go-to place. 10 out of 10!
Incredible! A veterinary clinic where the treatment for our pets is truly exceptional. I've met many veterinarians, and without a doubt, this is the best.
